python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import plistlib
p=Path('.local/apple-stt-benchmark')
s=(p/'probe.swift').read_text().replace('CommandLine.arguments[2]', '"'+str((p/'result-short.json').resolve())+'"').replace('CommandLine.arguments[1]', '"'+str(Path('.local/codex-transcription-research/probe-hebrew.wav').resolve())+'"')
(p/'app.swift').write_text(s)
a=p/'OpenCut Speech Test.app/Contents'
(a/'MacOS').mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
v=plistlib.loads((p/'Info.plist').read_bytes());v.update(CFBundleExecutable='probe',CFBundlePackageType='APPL',LSUIElement=True)
(a/'Info.plist').write_bytes(plistlib.dumps(v))
PY
swiftc .local/apple-stt-benchmark/app.swift -o '.local/apple-stt-benchmark/OpenCut Speech Test.app/Contents/MacOS/probe'
codesign --force --sign - '.local/apple-stt-benchmark/OpenCut Speech Test.app'
